plugins.Author: zbee, Liza Carvelli
plugins.Name: ARC
plugins.Description:
Instead of manually managing retainer plans for each individual character, which can get fairly tedious fairly quickly, we optimize this a bit and only manage "high-level" plans.

Originally made by Liza Carvelli - thank you for your work.
plugins.Changelog:
- Added catching for invalid Item IDs on the Retainers tab
- Fixed dependencies, bumped versions

(was unhappy with the frequency of errors in 8.6, so just didn't release it)
